description: Get a prediction market's price history as OHLCV candles (kind candles, the default) or its trades (kind trades, newest first). Prices are 0-1 probabilities. For candles, give from and to (default: the last 7 days) and leave interval on auto: the server picks the finest interval that keeps the answer within max_points candles. How far back history goes depends on the user's Assymetrix plan (Free: 30 days); when the plan cut the range, historyClamped is true and note says so.

from.description: Range start, ISO 8601 (UTC if no zone). Candles default to 7 days before "to"; trades default to no start.

interval.description: Candle interval. auto (default) picks the finest one that fits max_points.

kind.description: candles: OHLCV price history (default). trades: individual trades, newest first.

limit.description: Trades only: trades per page (default 50, max 100)

market_id.description: Market id from search_markets (e.g. "polymarket:0x…"), or a Polymarket condition id, a Kalshi ticker or a market slug

role.description: Trades only: taker (default) is one row per match; maker is one row per resting order filled; all is both

side.description: Trades only: just buys or just sells

to.description: Range end, ISO 8601 (UTC if no zone). Default: now.

name: get_market_history
title: Get market price history
